name: Viktor Kowalczyk
headline: Software Engineer
summary: Software Engineer building data-driven products and internal tools for image and language workflows. Experienced in shipping reliable services across cloud environments, improving quality through practical automation, and turning messy data into usable features. Comfortable working close to product and operations to deliver measurable improvements.
